Location

Edron, north of the castle gate

Notes

Lieutenant Falk is the harbour guard and protects the Edron castle. He will tell you the location of about everything around Edron, including hunting grounds.
His name is an allusion.

History

With the update 8.1 the outfit of NPC Falk changed. This is how he looked before the update:
.

Transcripts

To change these transcripts, edit the transcripts page for Falk.

Player: hi
Falk: LONG LIVE KING TIBIANUS! Welcome to the isle of Edron!
Player: name
Falk: I'm Lieutenant Falk.
Player: how are you?
Falk: I'm well prepared for my duty.
Player: job
Falk: I'm the Edron harbour guard. I protect Edron castle and inform visitors about this building and Edron itself.
Player: work
Falk: Explore the isle and destroy any enemy forces encountered. The honour shall be your reward.
Player: Edron / isle
Falk: This mysterious isle has many secrets and sights outside the castle. The areas of interest are in the west, the southwest, the north, and the northwest.
Player: west
Falk: There are rumours of two tribes of minor monsters who battle each other for dominance over the area. Not worth to crawl the sewers to get there.
Player: southwest
Falk: There are rumours of orc buildings in the southwest. They say some daring fellows found a passage to this area in an old cavern beneath the Edron flats.
Player: north
Falk: In the north, there is an ancient city of cyclopses, called the cyclopolis. They are wary of us, but trade with servants of evil from any known race.
Player: northwest
Falk: Don't even think about going there. Renegade Knights of Banor's Blood went there to unearth forbidden secrets in an ancient ruin.
Player: castle
Falk: The Edron castle is the heart of the city. It's the home of many shops, a tavern, a bank, a depot, a post office and the temple of Banor's blood.
Player: city
Falk: In the city there is a furniture store and a jeweller. The Noodles Academy and the cemetery are outside.
Player: Academy
Falk: The Noodles Academy of the magic arts is in the east of Edron city.
Player: cemetery
Falk: The cemetery is north of the hamlet of Stonehome, which is at the east coast, northeast of Edron city. The cemetary is rumoured to be haunted.
Player: shops
Falk: The shops are on the eastern side of the castle. Upstairs you'll find a tailor, a blacksmith, and an equipment store.
Player: tavern
Falk: The tavern is called the Horn of Plenty, and it's located upstairs in the southwest corner of the castle.
Player: bank
Falk: You'll find the bank in the southwest of the castle. Look for Ebenizer, you can't miss him.
Player: depot
Falk: The depot is in the southwest corner of the castle, on the first underground floor. The steps leading down to it are right next to the post office.
Player: post
Falk: The post office, run by the lovely Chrystal, is in the southwest corner of the castle, near the Royal Bank.
Player: temple / citizen
Falk: The temple can be found underground, in the southeast corner of the castle. There you can become a citizen of Edron.
Player: battlegroup
Falk: There are the Dogs of War, the Red Guards, and the Silver Guards.
Player: guard / army
Falk: The local army consists only of the Knights of Banor's Blood.
Player: Falcon
Falk: Well, my father was apparently quite fascinated with the story. My name is partially testament to that. ...
Falk: The tales about mysterious things going on at the top of the stronghold are greatly exaggerated if you ask me. But check it out for yourself if you like, I've had my fill of this.
Player: king / leader
Falk: LONG LIVE THE KING!
Player: news
Falk: Sorry, that's confidential.
Player: quest / mission
Falk: Explore the isle and destroy any enemy forces encountered. The honour shall be your reward.
Player: sell
Falk: Visit the shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.
Player: subject
Falk: We all live under the benevolent guidance of our king.
Player: idiot / (insult)
Falk: Take this!
(He will burn you.)
Player: bye
Falk: LONG LIVE THE KING!
